reference: If you leave one screw loose, the whole chair wobbles.
sk: Keď necháš jednu skrutku uvoľnenú, celá stolička sa kýve.
cz: Když necháš jeden šroubek povolený, celá židle se viklá.
acceptable: {If|When} you leave {one|a|a single|just one} screw loose, the {whole|entire} chair {wobbles|shakes}.
The {whole|entire} chair {wobbles|shakes} {if|when} you leave {one|a|a single|just one} screw loose.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you leave one screw loose, the whole chair will wobble.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o vždy platný fakt, preto v Zero Conditional patrí v oboch častiach Present Simple: „wobbles“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o vždy platný fakt, proto v Zero Conditional patří v obou částech Present Simple: „wobbles“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is always true, so Zero Conditional uses Present Simple in both parts: “wobbles”.

mistakes.text: If you will leave one screw loose, the whole chair wobbles.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ patrí Present Simple, nie „will“: „if you leave“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ patří Present Simple, ne „will“: „if you leave“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “if” use Present Simple, not “will”: “if you leave”.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you leave one screw loose, the whole chair wobble.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Podmet „the chair“ je v jednotnom čísle, preto v Present Simple treba „wobbles“ s -s.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Podmět „the chair“ je v jednotném čísle, proto v Present Simple je potřeba „wobbles“ s -s.
mistakes.feedback_en: “The chair” is singular, so Present Simple needs “wobbles” with -s.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you leave one screw loose, the whole chair is wobbling.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri všeobecne platnom fakte patrí Present Simple „wobbles“, nie Present Continuous.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U obecně platného faktu patří Present Simple „wobbles“, ne Present Continuous.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a general truth use Present Simple “wobbles”, not Present Continuous.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you leave one screw loose, all chair wobbles.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Celá stolička“ je po anglicky „the whole chair“, nie „all chair“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Celá židle“ je anglicky „the whole chair“, ne „all chair“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For one complete object say “the whole chair”, not “all chair”.
